name: sensitive-input
title: SensitiveInput
description: Kumo SensitiveInput: re-exports KUMO_SENSITIVE_INPUT_DEFAULT_VARIANTS, KUMO_SENSITIVE_INPUT_VARIANTS, SensitiveInput from @cloudflare/kumo/components/sensitive-input.
docs: Kumo needs Tailwind CSS v4. Your Tailwind CSS file now has @import "@cloudflare/kumo/styles/tailwind" and @source "../node_modules/@cloudflare/kumo/dist/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}". That @source path assumes the CSS file is one folder below node_modules (app/globals.css, src/index.css); fix it if yours is deeper. See https://github.com/tom-ricci/kumo-shadcn#styles
